It is evident in Elihu's continuing remonstrance that he was not inspired to know the special nature of Job's test at the hands of Satan. Yet he seems to have known that Job was being "tried" (Job 34:36)-perhaps as all mortals are tried. In any case he considered Job too hasty in deciding that God had taken away His justice; the same Hebrew word may mean both "judgment" and "justice.
